cleanup.absence_basis: See cleanup GetLayerVersion ResourceNotFoundException, ListLayerVersions empty, both regional ListLayers owned entries empty, ListObjectVersions empty before bucket removal, GetBucketPolicy NoSuchBucketPolicy, HeadBucket 404 and ListObjectVersions NoSuchBucket after removal. remaining_owned_resources is only valid when those observations succeed.

redaction.presigned_url: credential/signature/security-token query values redacted; URL and field presence retained
redaction.list_output: Only owned layer entries retained; page metadata and pagination fields preserved.
redaction.cloudtrail_access_key_id: Redacted as credential metadata; identity type, principal, account and ARN retained.

native_limitations: Public API outputs are botocore model-decoded JSON plus ResponseMetadata, not raw HTTP response bodies. CloudTrail event JSON is decoded without service-model projection.

Presigned Lambda-managed Location credential, security-token and signature query values are redacted; actual returned URL structure and field presence remain. No Location was present in any successful REFERENCE publish/GetLayerVersion model-decoded Content.

One 140-byte ZIP containing a 10-byte Python source file, one immutable S3 object version, and owning-account exact-object service permission were exercised; no runtime/function/lifecycle inference is made.

findings.cross_region_COPY: Both current and explicit S3ObjectVersion fail InvalidParameterValueException with PermanentRedirect; native message distinguishes GetObject from GetObjectVersion.
findings.cross_region_REFERENCE: Both current and explicit S3ObjectVersion succeed in us-east-1 against us-west-2; publish and GetLayerVersion Content have CodeSha256, CodeSize=140 and ResolvedS3Object with the exact immutable version, without Location.
findings.same_region_baseline: us-west-2 COPY and REFERENCE with explicit same S3 version both succeed. COPY publish/get include actual presigned Location; REFERENCE does not.
